responsibility: Defines LoongArch inline-assembly register classes and registers, covering integer and floating-point operand support, ABI and LLVM-reserved register rejection, accepted aliases, and operand emission names.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `abi/call/loongarch.rs`, this LoongArch file defines inline `asm!` registers and validation, including `$r`/`$f` aliases and ABI/LLVM-reserved register rejection, rather than function-call psABI classification.
